verdict.rationale: Zapier is a SaaS automation platform, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. It ships a first-party hosted MCP server (Zapier MCP). The docs explain how to connect any MCP client by creating a server and generating a connection token, and they cover server modes, access sharing, tool bundles and security (SOC 2, OAuth, connection-token auth). A probe confirms the official MCP server is documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP connection working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect any MCP client to Zapier MCP by creating a server and generating a connection token, then adding it as a Bearer header or query parameter.
Give any MCP-compatible AI client governed access to 9,000+ apps through one connection: no code, no infrastructure, SOC 2 certified.
Zapier MCP lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any other AI client take real action in the apps that run your business
Zapier MCP security: SOC 2 Type II certified with SAML SSO, OAuth, and connection token auth.
official MCP server documented at https://zapier.com/mcp
